pure-announcement.rationale: This is the project's standing README (install, architecture, security, community sections), not a launch, release note, or funding announcement — though its content is almost entirely product-bound.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (OSV format, proxy-boundary capture, shadow MCP detection, SIEM gap, MCP governance, Code Mode) describe OpenClaw or a self-hosted personal-assistant gateway.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Everything stated is checkable against the public repo, npm package, and docs site the note links to.

durability.rationale: The bulk is install commands pinned to specific Node/npm versions and a link farm into fast-moving docs; only the coarse Gateway-plus-channels architecture sketch and the product's existence will still hold in twelve months.

actionability.rationale: Every step is product-only — curl the installer, run `openclaw onboard`, open the dashboard — useful solely to someone adopting OpenClaw, not to how anyone builds or decides beyond it.

atomicity.rationale: Despite many README sections it describes exactly one thing, and the core idea — a self-hosted single-operator assistant whose local Gateway bridges models to consumer messaging channels — fits in one paragraph.
